waves.title: Ground truth I — durability law, auth ON, trio/index fence, briefCacheStale fix
waves.intent: Establish the non-negotiable substrate before any feature code: a proven storage primitive on the target box, an auth-ON-only suite, a CI fence that keeps this effort out of the trio and the already-built portfolio index, and the A3 defect fixed in Wave 1 as John's gate decision requires.
deliverables: Storage-primitive hammer test on the TARGET box (Windows, scanner + sync running): N concurrent appenders x M records asserting zero torn/lost/duplicated records; FAIL branch escalates to SQLite WAL, never a hardened file
Durability stated in hardening-law form: named atomic write helper + named lock helper + a concurrency test that FAILS if either is removed (removal-proof test)
Auth flipped ON: one suite, no auth-off variant; negative auth tests (absent / expired / wrong-principal / revoked) as first-class cases; CI guard that fails the build on any bypass flag

CI diff guard: build fails if the effort modifies any file under the Crucible, Foreman or researchPrime trees, or under Ecgberht/planning/steward-tracking-2026-07 and engine/portfolio/ beyond an explicit named-fix allow-list

A3 FIX in engine/brief.mjs: briefCacheStale staleness key extended from Strip-only (as_of + instruments.length + receipts.length) to include roadmap event count + Face version, entered as a named fix item on the diff-fence allow-list
Regression test: mutate ONLY the roadmap (and separately ONLY the Face) and assert the cached packet reports stale rather than serving further_gathering:false
waves.doneWhen: The concurrency hammer, the removal-proof durability test, the auth-ON negative tests and the A3 staleness regression tests are all green in one auth-ON suite, and the CI diff guard fails a deliberate out-of-fence edit while passing the named A3 fix.

gwt.given: A roadmap-only change lands on a project whose brief packet is already cached
gwt.then: briefCacheStale reports stale and a fresh packet is assembled instead of serving the cached packet stamped further_gathering:false

gwt.given: A branch that edits a file under the Foreman tree (or under engine/portfolio/ outside the named-fix allow-list)
gwt.then: the build FAILS naming the offending path, while the same run passes for the allow-listed A3 fix in engine/brief.mjs

gwt.given: The atomic-write helper or the lock helper is deleted from the durability path
gwt.when: the concurrency suite runs on the target box with scanner and sync active
gwt.then: the test fails loudly (no prose-only durability claim can pass this gate)

waves.title: Ground truth II — A1/A2/A4/A5 audit harnesses and the fix-item ledger
waves.intent: Prove empirically what the INTAKE ledger asserts about the BUILT Ecgberht/portfolio halves by driving them from executable audit harnesses against real fixtures, producing checked-in seam tables and a fix-item list — audits, never re-plans (NS non-goal 1).
deliverables: A1 commission-half wiring audit harness: executable probe driving proposeCommission (:141) / confirmCommission (:250) and verbCommissionPropose (:769) / verbCommissionConfirm (:836), emitting a checked-in table of actual parameters, returns and the wiring seams Anchor must call

A2 assembleBriefPacket coverage harness: a REAL campaign fixture (Face + Strip + roadmap + commission dossier + one dead run) driven through Q1-Q12, emitting a coverage table of which continuity facts are answered today vs which need the dossier join

A4 non-atomic confirm-pair defect harness: a kill-between-writes probe over job-lifecycle.mjs:929-944 demonstrating a roadmap-bound commission with no Strip receipt; recorded as a defect row, fix scheduled for the ledger-spine wave

A5 portfolio-index liveness audit: assertions that the index home resolves, the snapshot exists and rebuilds, steward query answers over the REAL portfolio without walking roots, engine/portfolio/anchor-contract.mjs is reachable, and DERIVED ingest fires on a live write
Single checked-in FIX-ITEM LEDGER (defect id, evidence file:line, owning wave) with every A5 gap scheduled before the portfolio-at-a-glance wave needs the index
waves.dependsOn: Ground truth I — durability law, auth ON, trio/index fence, briefCacheStale fix
waves.doneWhen: All four audit harnesses run green under auth ON against real fixtures, their seam/coverage tables are checked in, and every discovered gap appears in the fix-item ledger with an owning wave — with no rebuild of the portfolio index.

Named failure states for the spine (lock-contended / store-not-declared / write-refused) with unknown distinguished from empty

waves.title: Wave-0 kill gate — end-to-end campaign proof, two skills, auth ON
waves.intent: Prove the whole North Star in one campaign on a fresh project under auth ON: describe -> propose -> batch confirm -> commission -> execute -> validated handback -> reflection + next-stage proposal, exercising at least two commissioned skills, then kill everything and resume without re-asking.
deliverables: End-to-end campaign test on a FRESH project with auth ON, asserted on OUTCOMES (ledger state, rendered surfaces, projections) rather than plumbing
At least TWO different commissioned skills exercised in one campaign (e.g. researchPrime then Crucible/Foreman), each through propose -> confirm with who recorded
Kill-everything-then-resume leg inside the same campaign: all processes killed, contexts gone, project reopened, true state named including one dead run and one missing handback
Whole-campaign invariant sweep: zero chat turns persisted, zero spend outside a live envelope, exactly one roadmap_events writer, no High Seat write, no trio-tree modification
Criteria traceability report mapping each of NS criteria 1-13 to the passing test(s) that prove it
Gate report listing anything DEGRADED (e.g. one-run-at-a-time) by name rather than omitted
waves.dependsOn: Chamber UI — steps, proposals, confirmations, artifacts and spoken corrections
waves.doneWhen: One fresh-project campaign under auth ON runs description -> proposed scaffolding -> batch confirm -> commissioned stage -> validated handback -> reflection + next-stage proposal across at least two skills, survives kill-and-resume with the true state named, and every NS criterion 1-13 maps to a passing test.

gwt.given: A fresh project with auth ON
gwt.when: John describes an effort, batch-confirms the proposed scaffolding, confirms a commission, and the stage hands back validated
gwt.then: a reflection receipt with Oranges prompts and a next-stage proposal are produced, and the whole path is asserted on ledger and rendered outcomes rather than plumbing

gwt.given: That campaign mid-flight with one run dead and one handback never arrived
gwt.when: everything is killed and the project is reopened
gwt.then: the steward's first message names the true state including both anomalies and asks nothing already recorded

gwt.given: The completed campaign
gwt.then: zero chat turns are persisted, no spend occurred outside a live envelope, roadmap_events shows exactly one writer, the High Seat wrote nothing, and no file under the Crucible / Foreman / researchPrime trees was modified
